prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Mirewood: drowned trees and dark pools in a green, firefly-lit mire beneath heavy haze. A slow, mysterious melody with muted strings and glimmers of harp. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
